tests: tests/e2e/app.spec.ts::draws a wide diagram at a readable size that scrolls sideways, with a toolbar reachable by keyboard
findings.note: reviewer found the shown toolbar is absolutely placed over the drawing with no reserved gutter, so it can hide the top of a wide diagram; the e2e test checks toolbar visibility and focus but not overlap, and a geometry assertion (toolbar box not intersecting the drawn art) would fail on this head and on base

notes: No describe wraps app.spec.ts tests, so e2e names are bare titles. The only Vitest file is new (tests/unit/diagram.test.ts, importing new src/ui/diagram.ts), so on base it fails at import rather than on an assertion. The non-overlap rule in finding 2 is not literally in the MUST text; it came from an owner ruling, mapped to MUSTs 1 and 2 by judgement. MUSTs 1, 4 and 7 have only Playwright tests. Review report found in rv-diagram.jsonl (agent log).
